pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ A (Y ngược) bê tông: hai chân thẳng ôm ngoài mặt cầu, nghiêng vào nhau tới khe hẹp đỉnh bằng ở ≈0,8 chiều cao rồi liền thành đầu tháp đặc; dưới mặt cầu chân thu lại về bệ cọc lục giác (chân kim cương), có dầm ngang dưới dầm chủ; đỉnh tháp +125,5 m, cao 119,5 m từ đỉnh bệ (≈87 m trên mặt cầu); 128 dây văng màu xanh, 2 mặt phẳng nghiêng, 16 dây mỗi bên
pylons_en: 2 concrete A / inverted-Y pylons: straight legs straddling the deck lean in to a narrow flat-topped slot at ≈0.8 of the height and join in a solid head; below the deck they converge to a hexagonal pile cap (diamond foot), with a cross-beam under the girder; tip +125.5 m, 119.5 m above the cap (≈87 m above the deck); 128 blue stays in two inclined planes, 16 per side

model3d.notes: r13: Spans 150 + 350 + 150 m (TEDI, Trung Nam, VnExpress; press '650 m' is the whole stayed unit), no auxiliary piers. Two A / inverted-Y pylons ('hình chữ A', Tiền Phong, Tecco1; 'hình kim cương', Dân trí): pylon top +125.5 m above datum (Tiền Phong, VnExpress), 119.5 m from the pile-cap top to the tip (Người Quan Sát), 33 pylon lifts. Drawn with the water at datum: tip 125.5 m, cap top 6 m above the water, deck 28.5 m at the unit ends, ≈38.1 m at the pylons and 42.0 m at mid-span (crest 13.5 m, rise pylon→mid-span ≈3.9 m measured on a Tecco1 drone elevation), so ≈87.4 m of pylon above the deck. Navigation clearance 37.5 m (TEDI). Legs: straight, ≈6.4 m wide across at the deck with inner faces just outside the 28 m deck (±14.6 m), leaning in to a flat-topped slot ≈5 m wide at ≈69.6 m (0.8 of the above-deck height), then a solid head ≈12 → 7.6 m wide to the tip; below the deck the legs converge to the cap (diamond foot, feet ≈±11.5 m) with a ≈5 m deep cross-beam under the girder. Pile cap an elongated hexagon pointed across the river (≈24 × 52 m, 26 bored piles D2.5 m, 110–116 m deep). 128 blue stays = 16 per side per plane, two inclined planes anchored over ≈50–84 m on the legs and head; deck anchors ≈17–167 m (main) and 17–145 m (side) from the pylon (closure 8 m at mid-span). Concrete Pi-section girder (two edge girders), 28 m (28.3 m) deck, 6 lanes. Geometry measured on TEDI and Tecco1 photos (brief-r13-my-thuan-2.md).

pylon_custom.description: A / inverted-Y pylon (Mỹ Thuận 2): two straight legs straddle the deck (inner faces just outside it) and lean in to a narrow flat-topped slot at ≈0.8 of the above-deck height, above which they are joined in one solid head tapering to a flat top; below the deck the legs converge again to a hexagonal pile cap (diamond foot), with a deep cross-beam under the girder. Stays in two inclined planes anchored on the upper legs and the head.
